# How I want my resume written

The AI reads this guide each time it writes a resume. Change it to suit you.

- Two pages at most. One page is fine for a short career.
- Start with my name as a heading, then one line of contact details.
- A short summary of three or four lines, aimed at this role.
- Experience: newest job first. For each job: title, employer, dates, then three to five bullet points.
- Each bullet starts with a strong verb and says what changed because of my work.
- Use numbers only when they are in my master profile. Never round them up.
- Group skills by type (for example: languages, tools, ways of working). Put the ones this ad asks for first.
- Education and certifications last, unless the ad asks for them up front.
- Plain words. No buzzwords, no "passionate", no "results-driven".
- Australian spelling.
